Somos especialistas em desenvolver produtos de ponta, combinando nosso vasto know-how em automação com as tecnologias mais avançadas do mercado. Representamos também as soluções integradas mais completas de gestão de operações, consolidando nossa posição de liderança nas Américas. Presença Global e Compromisso Local Com uma sólida presença em toda a América Latina, contamos com escritórios no Brasil (Recife e Rio de Janeiro), na Colômbia (Bogotá) e nos Estados Unidos (Miami), além de representações locais em diversos países da região. Essa estrutura estratégica nos capacita a oferecer um atendimento ágil e personalizado, adaptando-nos às particularidades de cada mercado e garantindo soluções que atendem de forma eficaz às necessidades de nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa história! DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA Liderar a implantação e comissionar sistemas de telecomunicações, eletrônicos e elétricos, desenvolvendo rojetos, relatórios e laudos técnicos, dimensionando requisitos e funcionalidades dos sistemas, especificando sua arquitetura e testando suas funcionalidades. Implementar e coordenar projetos com participação de colaboradores internos e externos, criar documentação de acompanhamento e ministrar treinamentos. RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES Projetos: Realizar definições técnicas, elaborar arquiteturas e projetos construtivos/executivos de telecomunicações. Campo e Testes: Realizar Teste de Aceitação em Fábrica (TAF), configuração, parametrização e comissionamento em campo de equipamentos e sistemas de telecomunicações, TO e TI. Documentação: Elaborar Especificações Técnicas, Workstatements, Relatórios de Inspeção e Teste (PIT), Relatórios de Comissionamento e Databooks. Qualidade: Analisar e corrigir projetos “as built” e elaborar checklists de instalação. Treinamento e Suporte: Conduzir treinamentos para clientes externos e oferecer suporte técnico especializado, dimensionando requisitos e funcionalidades. Gestão: Coordenar atividades de campo e revisar Relatórios Diários de Obra (RDO). REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES Formação Mínima: Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação Formação Desejável: Pós graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação Conhecimentos técnicos: Sistemas e Redes: Tecnologias DWDM, SDH, MPLS, Rádio Digital, Teleproteção (OPLAT e Digital), Redes Ethernet (Routers, Switches e Firewalls), VoIP e CFTV. Administração de Redes: Configuração de VLANs, ACLs e protocolos de roteamento (OSPF, RIP, BGP, EGP). Ferramentas: Domínio de Microsoft Office (Avançado em Excel e Word) e conhecimento em AutoCad LT 2D. Sistemas Operacionais: Conhecimento de Microsoft Windows e ambientes Linux. Certificações Obrigatórias (Mínimo uma): Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) ou Huawei Certified ICT Associate (HCIA) – Datacom. Certificações Desejáveis: Fortinet (NSE 4 ou NSE 7), Cisco (CCNP Enterprise, Specialist Enterprise Core ou Infrastructure), ISO IEC 27001 (ISFS), Security+ ou NCSP (NIST). Idiomas (Diferenciais Estratégicos): Inglês Desejável (Nível B1 - CEFR): Essencial para documentação e suporte técnico. Experiência e Mobilidade: Experiência comprovada em sistemas de telecomunicações para empresas de missão crítica Disponibilidade para viagens Nossos Pacotes de Benefícios Plano de Saúde (100% custeado pela Netcon) Plano Odontológico (Opcional) Convênio com instituição de ensino Programa de bem-estar Seguro de Vida Cartão Multibenefícios Anuênio Premiação (por resultados) Banco de horas

review_candidates.description: Position Description Seattle City Light, a department of the City of Seattle, is one of the nation’s largest municipally owned utilities in terms of the number of customers served. Over the years we have worked very hard to keep Seattle's electricity affordable, reliable, and environmentally sound. Today, City Light is a recognized national leader in energy efficiency and environmental stewardship. The Transmission and Distribution Business Unit has openings for Journey Level Cable Splicers. Cable Splicers are responsible for splicing high voltage and secondary network systems (power cables used in underground distribution) and street lighting systems. This position installs, maintains and repairs electrical wiring systems. The work requires an expert knowledge of electricity and electrical theory, the methods and tools used in cable splicing, and safety rules and procedures. The ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematic drawings and to use specialized hand and power tools is also required. These positions will report to a Network Crew Chief/Supervisor and will report out of the North Service Center. Job Responsibilities Splices, maintains and terminates all types of high and low voltage power cables (lead-covered, gas-filled, oil-filled, etc.). Pulls, racks and secures high and low voltage cables in manholes, conduit, tunnels, vaults and other installations. Installs, maintains, repairs and removes high and low voltage conductors, transformers, network protectors, relays, switches, junction boxes and related electrical equipment. Installs, troubleshoots, maintains and repairs electrical equipment required for spot network distribution systems in high-rise buildings. Locates and repairs electrical faults in underground network distribution systems, substations and other distribution systems. Installs, reroutes, maintains and repairs street lighting systems and equipment. Bends, installs, maintains and repairs all types of conduits. Works with distribution system maps, feeder maps, and cut sheets to perform switching and tagging for power dispatchers to de-energize lines. Installs, maintains, troubleshoots and repairs protection systems, such as fire, anti-corrosion, and cathodic protection systems. Performs high voltage D.C. tests on power cables and equipment. Inspects work done by private contractors. Performs other duties of a comparable level/type as assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications: In addition to the skills and experience mentioned below, a successful applicant will have experience that reflects a commitment to creating fair and equitable outcomes and has: Experience: Requires three years of experience in the electrical trades working under the supervision of a journey level Cable Splicer with at least one year on a cable splicing crew (or a combination of education and/or experience which provides an equivalent background required to perform the work of the class). Certification/License: Current Washington State driver's license and a combination license or evidence of equivalent mobility. Work Environment/Physical Demand Works outdoors in all types of weather. Works with energized equipment and cables in confined areas, at heights, and in heavy traffic. Works with toxic/hazardous substances and molten lead and insulating compounds heated to 700º F. Work requires extended periods of physical exertion, including lifting and manipulating objects that weigh more than 50 pounds. May work nights, weekends and holidays. Desired Qualifications - You will be successful if you have the following experience, skills, and abilities: 4 years or more of high voltage electrical journey-level Cable Splicer experience. Additional Information Please note this job advertisement is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice . Emergency Response Commitment Seattle City Light is committed to reliable service during emergencies. Through our Emergency Response Program, each employee is assigned a role—usually aligned with their regular duties—to support emergency operations. Your participation is vital to helping the utility stay prepared and serve our community when it matters most. _______________________________________________________________________________________________________ The full salary range for this position is $77.36 to $77.36 per hour. Application Process Please Submit The Following With Your Online Application A cover letter in which you clearly describe how your knowledge, experience, skills, and abilities prepare you for the job responsibilities and qualifications outlined in the job announcement A current resume of your educational and professional work experience. Who May Apply : This position is open to all candidates that meet the qualifications. Seattle City Light values diverse perspectives and life experiences. Applicants will be considered regardless of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, marital status, disability, religious or political affiliation, age, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Seattle City Light encourages people of all backgrounds to apply, including people of color, immigrants, refugees, women, LGBTQIA+, people with disabilities, veterans, and those with diverse life experiences. Job offers are contingent on the verification of credentials and other information required by the employment process, including the completion of a background check. The background check will involve a criminal history check, which includes conviction and arrest records in compliance with the Seattle’s Fair Chance Employment Ordinance, SMC 14.17and the City of Seattle Personnel Rule 10.3. A driving history review may be conducted in compliance with SMC 4.79.020.Applicants will be provided an opportunity to explain or correct background information. Our investment interests span venture capital, private equity, deep tech, AI, real assets, and impact-aligned opportunities across sectors including healthcare, energy, food systems, housing, water, and the circular economy. This is an investment-focused role, rather than a traditional wealth-management or sales position. The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of our members' investment strategies, portfolios, capital allocation preferences, areas of interest, and investment mandates. They will then work with the Berkana team to identify relevant opportunities, assess their fit for individual members, and facilitate high-quality investment connections. The role sits at the intersection of private wealth, family offices, investment analysis, private markets, and investor relationships. Key Responsibilities Member Investment Intelligence Develop a detailed understanding of Berkana members' investment strategies and capital allocation preferences. Build and maintain investment profiles covering asset classes, sectors, geographies, ticket sizes, risk appetite, investment horizon, and liquidity preferences. Investment Opportunities Review and analyse investment opportunities relevant to Berkana members. Evaluate opportunities across VC, PE, private credit, real estate, deep tech, AI, impact, and other private-market strategies. Prepare concise investment briefs and opportunity summaries. Identify which Berkana members may be relevant for specific opportunities. Coordinate introductions between members and founders, fund managers, family offices, and other investment counterparties. Support members during initial evaluation and diligence processes. Identify potential co-investment and syndication opportunities between Berkana members. Investment Research & Intelligence Research investment themes, sectors, funds, managers, and emerging opportunities. Track developments across global private markets. Develop investment insights and intelligence for the Berkana community. Build and maintain a high-quality database of investment managers, funds, companies, family offices, and investment opportunities. Identify emerging investment themes that may be particularly relevant to UHNW women and family offices. Family Office & Investment Network Develop relationships with family offices, private equity and venture capital funds, private banks, asset managers, founders, investment professionals, and other relevant counterparties. Source high-quality investment opportunities for the Berkana ecosystem. Represent Berkana at selected investment meetings, private dinners, family-office gatherings, conferences, and roundtables. Develop a strong understanding of the GCC and international family-office ecosystem. Support for Berkana's Growth The primary focus of this role is investment, but the successful candidate will also support the development of Berkana's platform by: Identifying potential UHNW women and family offices who could be relevant to Berkana. Supporting strategic relationships with investment institutions and family offices. Identifying potential partnerships and co-investment opportunities. Contributing investment expertise to Berkana's events, roundtables, and member programming. The Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who understands how sophisticated capital is allocated. You may currently be working as a: Investment Manager Family Office Investment Manager Private Banker Wealth Manager Investment Advisor Private Markets Investment Professional Private Equity Associate / VP Venture Capital Associate / VP Family Office Advisor Investment Analyst / Associate Asset Management professional Requirements 5+ years of relevant experience in investment management, family office, private banking, wealth management, VC, PE, private markets, or investment advisory. Strong understanding of investment analysis and capital allocation. Strong knowledge of private markets and alternative investments. Strong understanding of portfolio construction and asset allocation. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills. High level of discretion and professionalism. Strong English communication skills. Existing relationships within the family-office or investment ecosystem are highly desirable. GCC experience is highly desirable. Missions Définir, mettre en œuvre et piloter la stratégie des systèmes d'information de la compagnie, garantir la disponibilité, la sécurité et la conformité réglementaire des infrastructures et applications, et accompagner la digitalisation des processus métier (souscription, gestion des sinistres, distribution, relation client) au service du développement commercial de la jeune compagnie.  Responsabilités 1- Stratégie et gouvernance SI  • Élaborer le schéma directeur des systèmes d'information aligné sur le plan de développement de la compagnie et le soumettre à la Direction Générale. • Choisir et déployer le core system assurance (gestion des contrats, primes, sinistres, réassurance) le mieux adapté à une compagnie en démarrage, en arbitrant entre solution existante, progiciel spécialisé (Core Insurance System) et développement spécifique. • Définir le budget SI annuel et piloter son exécution (investissements, licences, hébergement, prestataires). • Mettre en place la gouvernance SI (comités, politiques, procédures) et les tableaux de bord de pilotage de la fonction.  2- Infrastructure, exploitation et sécurité  • Concevoir et déployer l'infrastructure technique (réseau, serveurs, postes de travail, téléphonie, connectivité entre le siège et les futures agences). • Définir la stratégie d'hébergement (data center local, cloud régional ou international) en tenant compte des exigences de résidence des données et de continuité d'activité. • Mettre en place une politique de sécurité de l'information (contrôle des accès, chiffrement, sauvegardes, plan de continuité et de reprise d'activité — PCA/PRA). • Assurer la conformité avec la loi guinéenne relative à la cybersécurité et à la protection des données à caractère personnel, et être l'interlocuteur des audits SI menés par la BCRG ou des auditeurs externes. • Superviser la relation avec les prestataires et fournisseurs (opérateurs télécoms, hébergeurs, éditeurs, intégrateurs, réassureurs techniques). 3- Applications métier et digitalisation  • Piloter le déploiement des applications cœur de métier : souscription, gestion des sinistres, comptabilité et reporting réglementaire, gestion de la réassurance. • Développer les canaux digitaux de distribution et de relation client (portail agents, application mobile, paiement électronique, intégration avec les opérateurs de mobile money). • Garantir l'interfaçage du SI avec les partenaires externes (réassureurs, banques, opérateurs télécoms, autorités de régulation). • Mettre en place les outils de reporting et de pilotage (BI) pour la Direction Générale et les organes de gouvernance. 4- Management et organisation • Recruter, structurer et faire monter en compétences l'équipe SI (infrastructure, développement, support), progressivement à mesure de la croissance de la compagnie. • Encadrer les prestataires externes et sociétés de service en assistance technique (mode hybride équipe interne / externalisation dans les premières années). • Sensibiliser et former l'ensemble des collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique et à l'utilisation des outils métier.  Formation • Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Bac+5 en informatique, systèmes d'information, télécommunications ou équivalent. • Une certification en gouvernance ou sécurité SI (COBIT, ITIL, CISM, CISSP) est un atout apprécié. Expérience • Minimum 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle en systèmes d'information, dont une expérience significative de management (direction ou responsabilité SI). • Expérience dans le secteur de l'assurance, de la banque ou d'un secteur financier régulé fortement souhaitée. • Une expérience de mise en place de SI dans une structure en création ou en forte croissance constitue un atout majeur. Compétences techniques • Bonne connaissance des progiciels de gestion d'assurance (Core Insurance Systems) et des architectures applicatives associées. • Maîtrise des enjeux d'infrastructure (réseaux, cloud, data center), de cybersécurité et de protection des données personnelles. • Connaissance des problématiques réglementaires du secteur assurantiel en Guinée et, plus largement, en Afrique de l'Ouest. • Compréhension des outils de paiement mobile et des écosystèmes fintech / InsurTech ouest-africains. • Maîtrise de la gestion de projet SI (méthodes agiles et/ou classiques) et de la gestion budgétaire. Compétences comportementales • Leadership et capacité à structurer une fonction et une équipe à partir de zéro. • Vision stratégique alliée à un sens opérationnel fort (« hands-on »), indispensable dans un contexte de startup. • Rigueur, sens de la conformité et de la gestion des risques. • Excellent relationnel pour dialoguer avec la Direction Générale, les régulateurs, les partenaires techniques et les équipes métier. • Capacité d'adaptation et d'innovation dans un environnement en construction et en évolution rapide. Conditions particulières • Poste basé à Conakry avec déplacements ponctuels à pourvoir ASAP. • Rémunération et avantages à définir selon profil et grille salariale de la compagnie.

review_candidates.description: Job Details About IonQ IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance . Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. Location: Our office is located in Oxford, England (UK), with hybrid working Job ID: 1820 The Role We are looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Reliability Engineering team at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for finding, root-causing, and permanently resolving electronics and control hardware issues on our operational trapped-ion quantum computers, contributing to the team's mission of improving fleet uptime and driving down the operational cost of our commercial and development systems. You'll play an important part in owning the full lifecycle of electrical reliability fixes - from identifying a real-world bottleneck through to standardizing the resulting fix into every future build - working closely with Operations, Science, Manufacturing, and Engineering to keep our quantum systems running reliably and effectively. Responsibilities In this position, you will work on root-causing, designing, and deploying electronics system design fixes across our fleet of quantum systems, supporting the effective delivery of reliable, development and production hardware . You'll have the opportunity to drive system upgrades, standardize control and drive electronics across systems, and build the observability that catches problems before they cause downtime , contributing directly to the success of the Reliability Engineering team . Key Responsibilities Include Triage & root cause: Actively monitor, root-cause, and prioritize electrical, control-system, and drive-electronics issues on live systems based on severity and impact to uptime and performance. Solution development: Design, prototype, build, and test electrical fixes - spanning schematic capture, PCB layout, and board- and system-level test - taking solutions from concept through to permanent integration. Reliability upgrade leadership: Drive electrical workstreams for major fleet-wide upgrades (e.g. control-hardware consolidation, drive-electronics standardization, remote telemetry/monitoring for laser and system health) to reduce variance and downtime across systems. Retrofitting & deployment: Coordinate directly with Operations and Science teams to schedule, deploy, and retrofit upgrades onto live systems while managing operational constraints, and verify fixes improve system performance, reliability or operability. Documentation & standardization: Feed validated fixes back into engineering documentation, build manifests, and the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process so every improvement is baked into the baseline for all future builds. Requirements To be successful, you will need strong foundations in analogue, RF, and mixed-signal electronics design, experience with the Altium PCB toolset, familiarity with RF concepts and confidence working directly on operational hardware under time pressure. We're looking for someone who can translate a system-level reliability problem into a concrete engineering solution, work across Operations, Science, and Engineering to get it deployed safely, and document it so it sticks. You'd be a great fit with: Analogue and mixed-signal electronics: strong practical experience designing and debugging op-amp circuits, low-noise amplifiers, filters, ADC/DAC modules, grounding, shielding and common digital interfaces. Altium design control and documentation: strong experience managing evolving schematics and PCB designs in Altium, producing clear technical documentation, and establishing effective review, ERC/DRC, release and change-control processes. Fault-finding and electrical integration: able to diagnose power supplies, analogue circuits and control electronics, and develop reliable PCBs, adapters, connectors, breakout cables and harnesses. Stakeholder engagement and delivery: able to gather requirements, explain technical issues and trade-offs across different disciplines, and take solutions through testing, deployment and documentation. Bonus: familiarity with LVDS and FPGA-based control electronics, cryogenic or RF/microwave systems, and Python-based test automation or telemetry. new_matches.title: Project Controller
new_matches.description: Location: Jacksonville, FL Position Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports To: Director of Project Finance and Operations Travel: none Supervisory Responsibility: none Summary Objective The Project Controller plays a critical role in supporting financial management and control for our organization's projects. This role involves collaborating with project teams, monitoring project financials, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations, accounting standards and company policies. Project Controller will contribute to accurate financial reporting, budgeting, and forecasting to support the successful execution of projects. This position serves as the primary financial point of contact for assigned projects from award through closeout and is expected to be a proficient user of SAP S/4HANA, working daily in Project Systems and across the Procure-to-Pay cycle to ensure project costs are captured, controlled, and reported accurately. Essential Functions Ensure accurate and timely cost reports and financial data by fully reconciling project contract values, budgets, forecasts, and approved change orders. Verify that all reported values are backed by proper documentation to maintain transparency and audit readiness. Coordinate closely with project teams, procurement, receiving, and other departments to ensure alignment between operations and financial goals. Ensure all teams follow established procedures and policies to support accurate reporting and project execution. Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost control systems to track financial performance. Analyze variances between budget and actuals and recommend corrective actions to keep projects financially on track. Maintain project structures in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS), including WBS element setup, network activities, cost planning versions, budget releases, and settlement rules, ensuring structures reflect the contracted scope of work and support required reporting. Oversee the Procure-to-Pay cycle for assigned projects, including review of requisition and purchase order coding to the correct WBS elements, monitoring of goods receipt/invoice receipt (GR/IR) aging, and resolution of three-way match exceptions with procurement and accounts payable. Monitor open commitments, accruals, and actual costs in SAP to produce a complete and defensible estimate at completion (EAC) for each project, including quantification of risk, contingency, and pending change orders. Maintain project master data integrity across SAP modules, including cost centers, profit centers, activity types, settlement rules, and project system statuses, and coordinate with ERP support on issue resolution and enhancement requests. Prepare and update detailed project cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funding and timely disbursements. Coordinate with finance and project teams to align cash flow timing with billing, procurement, and execution milestones. Collaborate with project managers, procurement, and scheduling teams to align operational activities with financial plans. Support resource planning and identify risks that may impact cost or schedule. Assist in preparing documentation and reports for external audits. Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records and support compliance with internal Controller. Identify inefficiencies in project Controller and recommend process enhancements. Develop standardized tools, templates, and reporting formats to improve accuracy and consistency. Monitor compliance with company issued policies and procedures and take corrective action for non-compliance. Review and approve job cost transfers to ensure accuracy, proper justification, and alignment with project budgets and coding structures. Investigate project variances, submit variance reports to management and respond to requests for more detail from key stakeholders. Provide ongoing process and financial guidance to project teams and other departments whose activities impact project financials. Support informed decision-making by ensuring understanding of cost Controller, budgeting practices, and compliance requirements. Close out projects and project accounts upon project completion. Review daily operational and financial transactions (Purchasing, Invoice Logs, JSI) and investigate any unusual transaction. Establish clear deadlines for project financial deliverables and monitor compliance across teams. Identify and prioritize critical areas requiring timely action to prevent delays, cost overruns, or reporting gaps. Perform various month-end closing procedures, including preparation and review of project cost reports. Ensure all costs are captured, reconciled, and accurately reflected in financial systems. Respond to ad hoc requests from management or project teams by providing timely financial analysis, reports, or data as needed. Support revenue recognition for long-term contracts, including percentage-of-completion calculations, results analysis, and settlement in SAP PS, in accordance with ASC 606 and company accounting policy. Track client billings, retainage, and unbilled balances; support the preparation of progress billings and reconcile billed and recognized revenue to the project cost report. Prepare and issue monthly project review packages covering cost to date, estimate at completion, margin trend, contingency drawdown, cash position, and change order status for review with project managers and executive leadership. Participate in ERP and process improvement initiatives, including requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, and training of project teams on SAP workflows and reporting tools. Protect the confidentiality of all accounting and payroll data. Prepares for ISO 9001 and other audits. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Key Performance Indicators Accuracy and timeliness of monthly project cost reports, forecasts, and month-end close deliverables. Variance between reported estimate at completion and final project cost. Timeliness of GR/IR clearing and resolution of three-way match and invoice exceptions. Completeness of documentation supporting reported contract values, budgets, and approved change orders. Accuracy and integrity of project master data maintained in SAP S/4HANA. Absence of audit findings related to project financial records and internal Controller. Competencies Strong organizational skills. Independent work skills. Analytical, logic and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented with emphasis on accuracy and detection of errors and/or potential fraud. Ability to prioritize work to meet established deadlines. Strong interpersonal skills. Written and verbal communication skills. Time management. Accounting and Financial skills and knowledge. Job cost and project accounting concepts. Proficiency with ERP systems, particularly SAP S/4HANA. Advanced spreadsheet skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and analysis of large data sets. Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insight for non-financial audiences. Sound professional judgment and discretion in handling confidential information. Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. Collaborative, cross-functional approach to problem solving. Key Working Relationships Project Managers and Project Engineers – cost, forecast, change order, and closeout coordination. Procurement and Receiving – purchase order commitments, goods receipt, and supplier invoice resolution. Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable – invoice processing, progress billing, and collections support. Scheduling – alignment of cost and schedule data for progress and earned value reporting. Corporate Accounting – month-end close, revenue recognition, and audit support. ERP and IT Support – system access, master data, and issue escalation. Work Location This position will work out of our Main Office in Jacksonville, FL. This position is not approved for telecommuting or working remotely. Work Environment Most work is performed in an office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines. Physical Demands This is a largely sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary. Position Type/Expected Hours of Work This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required as job duties demand. Required Education And Experience. Bachelor degree in accounting and 3 to 5 years of relevant experience; or 10 years’ relevant experience. Preferred Education And Experience Job cost and project accounting. SAP S/4HANA experience. SAP Project Systems (PS) module, including WBS structures, project budgeting, cost planning, and settlement. Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process experience, including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, goods receipt, and invoice verification (three-way match). Experience in an engineering, construction, EPC, or capital equipment manufacturing environment with long-cycle projects. Familiarity with percentage-of-completion accounting and ASC 606 revenue recognition. Experience with SAP reporting tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, BW, or comparable business intelligence platforms. Experience supporting international projects, including multi-currency and intercompany transactions. CPA, CMA, or CCP certification, or active progress toward certification. Additional Experience And Skills Accounting and Financial skills and knowledge. Strong proficiency experience with MS Word, MS Excel and ability to use accounting software. General math skills. Job cost and project accounting concepts. Working knowledge of US GAAP as applied to job cost and project accounting. Advanced MS Excel, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and data modeling. Ability to extract, reconcile, and analyze data from SAP standard and custom reports. Ability to document and maintain desktop procedures, process flows, and internal Controller. Work Authorization Must be authorized to work in the USA. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. new_matches.description: Job Details About IonQ IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world's leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ's newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance . Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. Location: Our office is located in Oxford, England (UK), with hybrid working Job ID: 1820 The Role We are looking for a Senior Electronics Engineer to join our Reliability Engineering team at IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for finding, root-causing, and permanently resolving electronics and control hardware issues on our operational trapped-ion quantum computers, contributing to the team's mission of improving fleet uptime and driving down the operational cost of our commercial and development systems. You'll play an important part in owning the full lifecycle of electrical reliability fixes - from identifying a real-world bottleneck through to standardizing the resulting fix into every future build - working closely with Operations, Science, Manufacturing, and Engineering to keep our quantum systems running reliably and effectively. Responsibilities In this position, you will work on root-causing, designing, and deploying electronics system design fixes across our fleet of quantum systems, supporting the effective delivery of reliable, development and production hardware . You'll have the opportunity to drive system upgrades, standardize control and drive electronics across systems, and build the observability that catches problems before they cause downtime , contributing directly to the success of the Reliability Engineering team . Key Responsibilities Include Triage & root cause: Actively monitor, root-cause, and prioritize electrical, control-system, and drive-electronics issues on live systems based on severity and impact to uptime and performance. Solution development: Design, prototype, build, and test electrical fixes - spanning schematic capture, PCB layout, and board- and system-level test - taking solutions from concept through to permanent integration. Reliability upgrade leadership: Drive electrical workstreams for major fleet-wide upgrades (e.g. control-hardware consolidation, drive-electronics standardization, remote telemetry/monitoring for laser and system health) to reduce variance and downtime across systems. Retrofitting & deployment: Coordinate directly with Operations and Science teams to schedule, deploy, and retrofit upgrades onto live systems while managing operational constraints, and verify fixes improve system performance, reliability or operability. Documentation & standardization: Feed validated fixes back into engineering documentation, build manifests, and the Engineering Change Request (ECR) process so every improvement is baked into the baseline for all future builds. Requirements To be successful, you will need strong foundations in analogue, RF, and mixed-signal electronics design, experience with the Altium PCB toolset, familiarity with RF concepts and confidence working directly on operational hardware under time pressure. We're looking for someone who can translate a system-level reliability problem into a concrete engineering solution, work across Operations, Science, and Engineering to get it deployed safely, and document it so it sticks. You'd be a great fit with: Analogue and mixed-signal electronics: strong practical experience designing and debugging op-amp circuits, low-noise amplifiers, filters, ADC/DAC modules, grounding, shielding and common digital interfaces. Altium design control and documentation: strong experience managing evolving schematics and PCB designs in Altium, producing clear technical documentation, and establishing effective review, ERC/DRC, release and change-control processes. Fault-finding and electrical integration: able to diagnose power supplies, analogue circuits and control electronics, and develop reliable PCBs, adapters, connectors, breakout cables and harnesses. Stakeholder engagement and delivery: able to gather requirements, explain technical issues and trade-offs across different disciplines, and take solutions through testing, deployment and documentation. Bonus: familiarity with LVDS and FPGA-based control electronics, cryogenic or RF/microwave systems, and Python-based test automation or telemetry.
